body: Addressed in e965b6b59. validateRouteContract now enforces protectedMode === jwtRequired in both directions. The six requested jwt_required/public/authenticated/ownership combinations are covered by table-driven regression tests in route-security-guard.test.js.

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Accessing `.authMode` directly on the result of `getRoutePolicy(route)` can throw a `TypeError` if the policy is not found or is undefined. Use optional chaining to safely resolve the `authMode` and prevent potential runtime crashes. Additionally, when adding robustness checks like optional chaining, ensure you include regression tests to verify that the system fails closed gracefully rather than throwing unhandled TypeErrors.

```suggestion
  const authMode = route.authMode || getRoutePolicy(route)?.authMode;
```

1. When adding robustness checks (such as optional chaining or Array.isArray) for potentially malformed or missing input data, include regression tests to verify that the system fails closed gracefully (e.g., returning a failure status) rather than throwing unhandled TypeErrors.
